note: NECO Agricultural Science Paper III round 1: the full SSCE syllabus - meaning and importance of agriculture, crop production (classes, rotation, monoculture, mulching), soil science (texture, profile, leaching, lime), animal production (terms, housing, ruminants, Newcastle), farm tools and machinery, pests and diseases (biological control, herbicides), crop propagation (grafting, layering, stakes), agricultural economics and extension, farm records and surveying, agro-allied industries, fisheries and forestry - with Nigerian crops, animals and settings. Near-dup scanned against the JAMB, WAEC and existing NECO banks.
